rows.label: qst201007_msg0002
rows.name:
'Recently, attacks have surged across
several countries, with people losing
their Core Crystals to the attackers.'

rows.label: qst201007_msg0003
rows.name:
'These incidents are commonly known as
Core Crystal hunting. A similar case
occurred in Gula the other day.'

rows.label: qst201007_msg0004
rows.name:
'The Security Department is currently
investigating, but the culprit has
not yet been identified.'

rows.label: qst201007_msg0005
rows.name:
'If you see anyone suspicious, please
contact Security at the Superbian
Imperial Army's Torigo Base.'
